document.abstract: The rapid development of microelectronic components and the related technology during the last years has made a lot of applications feasible for digital signal processing in the field of television. Especially the availability of cheap field or frame memories has focused the interest on techniques with temporal processing components as e. g. Standards conversion, improved PAL and NTSC coding and transmission /1/,/2/, compatible or noncompatible HDTV bandwidth reduction coding techniques as MUSE /3/ or HD-MAC /4/ as well as display conversion for flicker-free TV-reproduction. The latter shell be dealt with in more detail in this paper.
